London Bus Strike Suspended Amid Driver Vote on New Deal

A planned strike by approximately 1,500 London bus drivers has been suspended. The drivers were set to walk out over a pay dispute. The suspension comes as drivers will now vote on a new deal proposed by the employers. The outcome of this vote will determine the future of the industrial action.
